baseline.text:
SQL (Structured Query Language) and NoSQL (Not Only SQL) are two different types of database management systems that have their own strengths and weaknesses.

SQL databases are relational databases that store data in tables with predefined schemas. They use a structured query language to retrieve, insert, update, and delete data from the database.
